title: Subtile
html_source:
Subtile is not commonly used as a countable noun but here essentially means “subtlety”.

The etymology is cool: From Latin subtilis (“fine, thin, slender, delicate”), perhaps, from sub (“under”) + tela (“a web, fabric”). See tela, toil.
